limitations: Host retains GDB ownership and supplies observed time; fixed reused token does not independently prove freshness, correlation or origin.
Exact measured MI frame syntax only; no generic MI compatibility. Frame-length validation is not bounded streaming transport.

Initial guarded, cases-01, normalized-01 and session-01 reports predate strict timestamp conversion and are retained with original hashes. Final tests and recovery use from_chars to reject signed/overflow input.
Real backend loss controls occur before final readback; malformed final ingress is tested separately using Windows pipes.
No debugger allowlist expansion, new MCU or temporal capability, commit or remote publication.
